requirements.text: Signed-out patrons sign in first and land in the same place.

Search, My Profile, Club Admin, FloqAi, Inbox / email / SMS notification links, Back buttons, sign-in return links and the My Profile Work Calendar frame all open plain URLs, so a saved or shared link always gets the current release.
The Subscription card stays visible after sign-in, and choosing a club no longer writes to the club record.
Frontend code must never contain AI API keys.
The frontend must not expose AI API keys.
